description: This file is a shell script for testing merge logic in fetch operations within a Git repository. It sets up environment variables, defines functions for processing scripts, performs Git operations like commits, tags, branch setups, and runs fetch tests with comparisons of expected and actual results.

methods.name: build_script
methods.description: Creates a script that performs substitutions on object IDs for files in the test setup.

methods.name: convert_expected
methods.description: Converts expected files by applying a sed script for comparison in tests.
